name: Naie (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Naie town emblem in red: a stylised bird-like device with two curving wings and a knob at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Naie, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 18 March 1954.

features.role: Naie town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with two curving wings and a knob at the top
